annotations.title: Prepare a VAT return to file in the browser

description: Works out the VAT return for the quarter ending on periodEnd from the open DIYA-GL book, as derive_vat_return does, and answers a link to the VAT return form on DIY Accounting Submit with the seven figures filled in (the form works out boxes 3 and 5). The person opens the link, checks the figures on the page, ticks the declaration and files there. Use this when the person asks to file, submit or send their VAT return or their MTD VAT for a quarter. It never files anything and contacts no outside service: the figures filed are the ones the person sees on the page.

periodEnd.description: The obligation's period end, YYYY-MM-DD; must be a month end the book's VAT interface carries

periodStart.description: The obligation's period start, YYYY-MM-DD; refused unless it opens the quarter ending periodEnd
